frames.narration: The app knows one address, api.shop.com. It sends a request with its access token.
Stage 1: the gateway verifies the token. This is done once here, not separately in every service.
Stage 2: it checks the caller's rate limit. A caller over the limit would get 429 right here, and no service would see the request.
Stage 3: it routes by path. /orders goes to the order service, /users to the user service and /pay to the payment service.
The answer returns through the gateway, which adds logging and metrics for every request in one place.
Now the payment service is slow. The gateway has a timeout and a circuit breaker for it, so it answers quickly instead of hanging.
Orders and users keep working normally. The gateway contained the failure at the edge, and clients still see one stable address.
